material.description: External fact (checked live in drain-g-1): the browser probe steps named by direct-peer-attack-refused-flake, moba-attack-move-probe-flaky-0fd7d47 and moba-range-refusal-probe-not-shown were removed with ci.yml itself. The contents API returns 404 for .github/workflows/ci.yml at 129d0a4a; it was re-created at 02a1139f (1104 bytes) and is now 3000 bytes (blob c9a2af41, 79 lines) with three jobs only: rust workspace tests, wire codec round-trip, static client checks. Tracked-tree codesearch finds none of fxWait, remoteCasts, srflx, refusal=attack_refused, pos=168.76, moba-input or 'neither travelled' in any file (dispatches 1792849117460, 1792849123591, 1792849124030, 1792849124257, 1792849124509, 1792849129507, 1792849130109, 1792849145232). The failing runs the rows cite ran the older 261,612 to 262,080 byte ci.yml: run 39579239759 at ad8c826 was created 2026-10-21T09:44Z, before 129d0a4a. Edit lane: no ci.yml change is possible without restoring a removed 260 KB workflow.
